leave_sick_days_001.evidence: Personal and local sick leave is earned on a one day per semester basis.

leave_sick_accrual_002.evidence: Personal and local sick leave is earned on a one day per semester basis. Leave is available for the employee’s use as it is earned.

leave_sick_family_003.evidence: Sick leave may be used for the following reasons only: ... Illness in the employee’s immediate family

leave_personal_days_004.evidence: State law entitles all employees to five days of paid personal leave per year.

leave_personal_restrictions_005.answer: Discretionary leave requires 2 days advance notice, is first-come first-served, and considers program impact/substitute availability; nondiscretionary leave is granted as sick leave.
leave_personal_restrictions_005.evidence: An employee wishing to take discretionary personal leave must submit a notice of the request 2 days in advance... Discretionary personal leave will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis. The effect of the employee’s absence on the educational program or department operations, as well as the availability of substitutes, will be considered...

leave_personal_conversion_006.evidence: There is no limit on the accumulation of state personal leave, and it can be transferred to other Texas school districts and is generally transferable to education service centers.
